title: Building a new array
summary: Leaving the caller's array alone, and filling Fibonacci.

steps.title: Don't change theirs
steps.say: Changing `values[i]` changes the caller's array too: they share it. Make a new one the same length and fill that.

steps.title: Sorting a copy
steps.say: `Arrays.copyOf` makes a copy you can sort without touching the original.

steps.title: Fibonacci
steps.say: Each slot depends on the two before it. Fill the first two, then loop from slot 2.
